# software id = <redacted-by-obi>
#
# model = RBD52G-5HacD2HnD
# serial number = EBEEF0BBA496
/interface bridge add name=bridge vlan-filtering=yes
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether1 ] name=ether1-uplink
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether5 ] name=ether5-management
/interface wireless set [ find default-name=wlan1 ] band=2ghz-b/g/n channel-width=20/40mhz-XX disabled=no distance=indoors frequency=auto installation=outdoor mode=ap-bridge name=wlan2.4-evn-net-20 ssid=evn-net-21 wireless-protocol=802.11
/interface wireless set [ find default-name=wlan2 ] band=5ghz-a/n/ac channel-width=20/40/80mhz-XXXX distance=indoors frequency=auto installation=outdoor mode=ap-bridge name=wlan5-evn-net-20 ssid=evn-net-22 wireless-protocol=802.11
/interface vlan add interface=bridge name=vlan321-mgmt vlan-id=321
/interface vlan add interface=bridge name=vlan3401-manage vlan-id=3401
/interface wireless security-profiles set [ find default=yes ] authentication-types=wpa2-psk mode=dynamic-keys supplicant-identity=MikroTik
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether2 pvid=3401
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether3 pvid=3401
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether4 pvid=3401
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=wlan2.4-evn-net-20 pvid=3401
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=wlan5-evn-net-20 pvid=3401
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether1-uplink pvid=3401
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether5-management pvid=3401
/ipv6 settings set disable-ipv6=yes
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bridge vlan-ids=321
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bridge vlan-ids=3401
/ip address add address=172.21.252.1/24 disabled=yes interface=ether4 network=172.21.252.0
/ip dhcp-client add interface=vlan321-mgmt
/ip dhcp-client add interface=vlan3401-manage
/ip dns set servers=172.28.0.101,172.28.0.102,192.0.2.8
/system clock set time-zone-name=America/Los_Angeles
/system identity set name=manzanita-ap
/system logging add action=disk topics=critical
/system logging add action=disk topics=error
/system logging add action=disk topics=info
/system logging add action=disk topics=warning
/system note set show-at-login=no
/system ntp client set enabled=yes
/system ntp client servers add address=172.18.84.11
/system ntp client servers add address=172.18.84.12
/system routerboard settings set auto-upgrade=yes
/tool bandwidth-server set authenticate=no
/tool romon set enabled=yes
